items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I liked that group, because he and – his group and the Jazz Messengers were really the same group... Then Horace broke loose and created his version of the Jazz Messengers, the Horace Silver Quintet

ctx.x: I believe that. Who were some of the musicians that you went to see while you were there? Who did you admire?

I liked Randy Weston. I worked with Randy at that time. Randy was very creative. At that time he did all of what I consider his best tunes. Horace Silver. I liked that group, because he and – his group and the Jazz Messengers were really the same group, because the original Jazz Messengers was Horace Silver on piano, Art Blakey on drums.
